extracted.name: Garlic Mustard Vinaigrette
extracted.description: This garlic-Dijon vinaigrette is a simple and speedy salad dressing that combines the flavors of Dijon mustard and garlic. Whip this up anytime.
instruction_lines: In a small bowl, mix sugar, salt, red wine vinegar, Dijon mustard, and olive oil until thoroughly mixed and sugar and salt have dissolved. Stir in garlic.
